default.description: Best known SGLang command for the benchmark repo default profile.
default.notes: Keep this profile updated when the best command changes for a SGLang release or commit. Policy-aligned candidate (compile on, offload off) — NOT yet validated on H100; validate (incl. OOM risk) before publishing. REQUIRED, not tuning: this case sets guidance_scale=1.0 with no negative prompt, so its requests do not use CFG. Without an explicit parallelism flag the runtime auto-enables CFG parallelism from the MODEL's default sampling params (_model_default_uses_cfg), the server starts, and then input_validation rejects every request -- correctly, since cfg-parallel leaves rank 1 with no work and would otherwise hang ~30 min on a gloo timeout. Measured 2026-09-13 on 4xB200 with scripts/run_profile_vs_default.sh: stripping the pin makes this cell unservable. Do not drop `--tp-size` here on the grounds that the runtime would choose for itself.

blackwell-cudnn.description: Blackwell vLLM-Omni profile for qwen_image_edit_2511 using cuDNN attention.
blackwell-cudnn.notes: Blackwell attention choice, measured on this box 2026-09-12. FLASH_ATTN is a Hopper-only precompiled kernel -- vLLM-Omni refuses it on sm_100 with 'FLASH_ATTN was explicitly selected but is unsupported'. FLASHINFER_ATTN starts but dies under torch.compile on dynamic shapes (`AsPythonConstantNotImplementedError: SymNodeVariable() is not a constant` in the FlashInfer backend's _ensure_plan), observed on qwen-image and cosmos3 t2v; it is fine for the static image cases (zimage, flux), which are deliberately left on it. CUDNN_ATTN is exact softmax, the same precision class as the kernels the other frameworks run here, measured at 2.741s on qwen-image (vs TRTLLM_ATTN 3.274s) and already the backend minimax-h3 serves with on this box.

default.description: ComfyUI master, core nodes only, the model's official workflow with full-precision weights.
default.notes: Official 'Image Edit (Qwen 2511)' blueprint (bf16 DiT; bf16 text encoder in place of fp8_scaled). guidance_scale 1.0 = no CFG. The output latent is an empty latent at the case's size rather than the VAE-encoded input, so ComfyUI renders the same 1024x1024 the other rows render; the reference still enters through TextEncodeQwenImageEditPlus (VL tokens + reference latent). The Comfy files need no Edit Model Reference Method node, per the blueprint's own note. Weights are the full-precision single-file checkpoints ComfyUI loads (Comfy-Org repackaging or the model's own single-file release); the official template's fp8/int8/nvfp4 defaults are swapped out because they are a different numeric class from every other row. Sampler, scheduler and shift follow the official ComfyUI workflow; steps, CFG, size, frames and seed follow the case. Compile on: the core TorchCompileModel node (inductor) goes behind every diffusion-model loader, as the other competitors run compile-on; measured on FLUX.1 / 1xB200 2026-09-25 at 4.89s against 5.94s and 5.77s eager.

blackwell-gpuonly.description: Blackwell: the default graph with every model resident on the GPU (--gpu-only).
blackwell-gpuonly.notes: B200: --gpu-only keeps every model, text encoders included, stored and run on the card; a 183 GB B200 holds the largest graph here (MiniMax-H3: 62 GB DiT + 48 GB Qwen3-VL-32B + VAEs). Placement only, numerics unchanged. Measured 2026-09-25 on 1xB200, FLUX.1 eager, interleaved arms: default 5.94 / 5.77 / 5.79s against --gpu-only 5.56s and --gpu-only --disable-dynamic-vram 5.57s (Qwen-Image-2.1: 3.75 / 3.91 against 3.47 / 3.48) -- every --gpu-only arm below every default arm; disabling dynamic VRAM on top adds nothing, so the simpler flag is kept.
